title: Chatgpt c00lkidd gui
script:
--// GUI CREATION
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
gui.Name = "CoolGui"

-- Movable Frame
local frame = Instance.new("Frame", gui)
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 250)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.25, 0)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true

-- Title
local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", frame)
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
title.Text = "Custom GUI by ChatGPT"
title.TextScaled = true

-- Tabs
local musicTab = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
musicTab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 40)
musicTab.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 50)
musicTab.Text = "[ Music ]"
musicTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 255)

local modsTab = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
modsTab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 170, 0, 40)
modsTab.Position = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 50)
modsTab.Text = "[ Mods ]"
modsTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)

-- Tab Pages
local musicPage = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
musicPage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -120)
musicPage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100)
musicPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1

local modsPage = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
modsPage.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -120)
modsPage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 100)
modsPage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
modsPage.Visible = false

-- MUSIC BUTTON
local musicButton = Instance.new("TextButton", musicPage)
musicButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
musicButton.Text = "Play C00LKidd Theme"
musicButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 255)
musicButton.TextScaled = true

musicButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local sound = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("C00LKiddTheme")
	if sound then
		local clonedSound = sound:Clone()
		clonedSound.Parent = player.Character
		clonedSound:Play()
	end
end)

-- F3X BUTTON
local f3xButton = Instance.new("TextButton", modsPage)
f3xButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
f3xButton.Text = "Get F3X"
f3xButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 255, 180)
f3xButton.TextScaled = true

f3xButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local tool = game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("F3XTool")
	if tool then
		tool:Clone().Parent = player.Backpack
	end
end)

-- SKYBOX BUTTON
local skyButton = Instance.new("TextButton", modsPage)
skyButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
skyButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 60)
skyButton.Text = "Coolio Skybox"
skyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 255)
skyButton.TextScaled = true

skyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
	lighting.Sky.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://8508980536"
end)

-- TAB SWITCHING
musicTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	musicPage.Visible = true
	modsPage.Visible = false
end)

modsTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	musicPage.Visible = false
	modsPage.Visible = true
end)
